title: The China Computer Federation calls for a boycott of AI conference NeurIPS after organizers barred submissions from US-sanctioned companies like Huawei (Vincent Chow/South China Morning Post)
summary: Vincent Chow / South China Morning Post: The China Computer Federation calls for a boycott of AI conference NeurIPS after organizers barred submissions from US-sanctioned companies like Huawei — Move to comply with US sanctions sparks backlash, with China's top computing body threatening to blacklist the AI conference
